description: React component for triggering a popover to edit adhoc filters in Apache Superset's explore interface.

classes.name: AdhocFilterPopoverTrigger
classes.description: React component class that manages the display and behavior of a popover for editing adhoc filters.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, binds methods, and sets initial state.

methods.name: onPopoverResize
methods.description: Handles resize events for the popover, forcing an update.

methods.name: closePopover
methods.description: Closes the popover by setting visibility to false.

methods.name: togglePopover
methods.description: Toggles the popover visibility based on the boolean argument.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the ControlPopover component with the overlay content for editing filters.
